verdict.rationale: gstack ships a persistent headless Chromium daemon behind a compiled CLI ($B) as its default browser fallback. Its autoplan pipeline runs review skills sequentially with auto-decisions, and the ship skill chains tests, versioning, commit, push and PR creation. Together these suggest non-interactive automation, but nothing documents running gstack itself headlessly or in a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive invocation of gstack skills, CI integration guidance or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
